title: Opinion: The flood problem is a planning problem
content: Long-form piece arguing that drainage capacity in the Klang Valley has not kept pace with development approvals. It runs through two decades of master plans, permit data, and the repeated failure to enforce retention pond requirements on new commercial developments across three state administrations.
author: Dr. Sharifah Lim
